outlet: The Spokesman-Review, 'Cheney Public Schools will have two levies on November ballot' (Elena Perry, 2026-07-16)
notes: Both are three-year renewals; combined school rate with the 2024 bond $3.90 vs $3.93 now; EP&O about $57 million, 16.5% of operating revenue last year, $2.10; capital about $4.1 million at 10, 15, 20 cents; most of the 2024 bond went to Skyway Elementary. Says collection begins 2027 (the ballot title says 2028).
